senses.gloss:
mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Malicious, wicked, hurtful, injurious, mischievous, destructive.
E.
नृ man, शसि to hurt, aff. अण्.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Practising mischief.
E.
नृशंश, add वृत्त engaged in.

m. (-हः)
1 VIṢṆU.
2 The fourth Avatāra or descent of that deity, in the shape of a man, with the head and claws of a lion.
3 A chief, a noble, a great or illustrious man.
E.
नृ a man, and सिंह a lion; applied in composition, also to signify pre-eminence.

nf. (-नं-ना)
An army of men.
E.
नृ a man, and सेना an army.

m. (-मः)
An illustrious or great man, a prince or chief.
E.
नृ mankind, and सोम the moon, here implying superiority or excellence.
